content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00019, SRS_Rte_00049 If a RunnableEntity implementing a server operation is mapped to an OsTask , and the RteServerNumberOfRequestProcessing of the related RteEventTo- TaskMapping is configured, the RTE shall dequeue and process only X (where X is the configured value of RteServerNumberOfRequestProcessing parameter) pending requests per OsTask execution.
